page_title: FIO 2-2 TOR | Fiorentina v Torino 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) earns the yellow card.
90+4' 2 - 2 Guillermo Maripan (Torino) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
90+3' It's a yellow card for Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
90+2' Marco Baroni is stunned as referee Andrea Colombo shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+2' Referee Andrea Colombo has finally had enough of Paolo Vanoli and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee shows the yellow card to Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
88' A corner kick by Fiorentina is thwarted by the well prepared Alberto Paleari (Torino).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moise Kean trots off the pitch and is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch for Manor Solomon.
83' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Che Adams and he is replaced by Duvan Zapata (Torino).
80' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
77' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
73' The substitution has been made. Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) has replaced Rolando Mandragora.
73' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) replacing Marco Brescianini.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
69' Substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Valentino Lazaro walks off.
66' The booking goes to Luca Marianucci (Torino).
64' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) gets a yellow card.
61' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
59' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Emirhan Ilkhan is replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Torino).
59' It's time for a substitution. Giovanni Simeone (Torino) comes on in place of Sandro Kulenovic.
57' 2 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Jack Harrison sets up Moise Kean (Fiorentina) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
56' The ball possession at the moment is 58:42.

56' A neat pass is well received by Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
55' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
53' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) is teed up on the edge of the box by Rolando Mandragora, and his howitzer of a shot into the top right corner gives the keeper no chance. 1:1.
50' Great teamplay by Fiorentina as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
48' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Albert Gudmundsson limps off the pitch to be replaced by Jack Harrison (Fiorentina).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Rafael Obrador is replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
46' Referee Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Fiorentina are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
40' Booking. Dodo (Fiorentina) receives a caution from the referee.
40' The corner is flicked onto Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina), but his close-range header flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
39' The referee signals a corner kick to Fiorentina.
37' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

36' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
35' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
35' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
34' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.
34' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.
31' The yellow card is received by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).

30' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the bottom left corner, but Alberto Paleari pulls off a great save to deny him.
30' Shots on target – 1:1.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! Cesare Casadei (Torino) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header in the bottom left corner after a good run and cross by Emirhan Ilkhan.
23' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
22' Luca Marianucci (Torino) is penalised for holding. Andrea Colombo signals a set piece.
20' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' Neat passing move from Fiorentina in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Ball possession – 60:40.

12' The corner is swung in and Saul Coco (Torino) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
11' Torino will take a corner kick.
11' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
10' The Fiorentina players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
9' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

9' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.

7' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
7' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
7' Sandro Kulenovic (Torino) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Torino earn a corner.
6' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Alberto Paleari.
6' Fiorentina win a corner.

5' The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner. A pass lands at the feet of Moise Kean (Fiorentina) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
4' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
2' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Torino will kick the game off.
Andrea Colombo was nominated as the referee for this game.
